newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
President Jiang Zemin calls for all leading officials to expand their legal knowledge to help ensure long-term stability of the state.
National trade unions federation tells members to learn from model Beijing bus conductress Li Suli.
China to register all state-owned assets held overseas.
Deng Xiaoping joins state leaders in sending condolences to family of dead former foreign trade minister Li Qiang.
Industrial growth slows as China's tight credit policy makes factory managers keep a sober mind when borrowing from banks.
China to develop ambitious range of new space technology in the 21st century, officials tell international astronautical congress in Beijing.
Chinese and foreign oil companies report new oilfield found in South China Sea.
Head of cabinet's Securities Committee calls for bigger role for China's stock markets.
Chinese official outlines reform targets for pension schemes.
Xi'an city in northern China orders 216 firms to close for causing serious pollution.
